sources.title: Milio Build Guide : [26.19] Milio Support | In-Depth Guide
Milio Build Guide : Morbilio|16.19|How to Set Allies on Fire

passive.name: Fired Up!
passive.text: Milio's abilities enchant allies on touch, making their next damage deal a burst of extra damage and burn the target.

spells.name: Ultra Mega Fire Kick
spells.text: Kick a ball that knocks back an enemy. The ball launches upward on hit and falls toward the enemy, damaging and slowing enemies in the area upon impact.

spells.name: Cozy Campfire
spells.text: Create an empowering zone that heals allies and increases attack range to those inside. The zone follows the ally nearest to the cast point.

spells.name: Warm Hugs
spells.text: Milio tosses a shield to an ally, temporarily increasing their movement speed. This ability has 2 charges.

spells.name: Breath of Life
spells.text: Milio unleashes a wave of soothing flames that heal and remove crowd control effects from allies in range.

damage.value: Milio deals bonus magic damage and a sustained burn through Fired Up!

archetype.value: Milio is a support who empowers allies and protects them with defensive utility.

axis.value: Milio plays defensively rather than poking, since his guide says he has no real poke tool beyond Ultra Mega Fire Kick.

winCondition.value: Milio wins by positioning well, protecting carries and timing abilities to change fights.

spikes.why: Milio gains synergy between the item and Cozy Campfire.

bait.why: Milio cannot counter-engage without Ultra Mega Fire Kick when it is unavailable.
Milio loses access to Cozy Campfire for 29 seconds after using it at level 1.

mistakes.value: Milio loses value when Milio forces plays instead of staying patient and making smart decisions.
Milio can leave himself without a counter-engage tool by spending Ultra Mega Fire Kick too early.
